A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, renamed from GPTQv2 to GPTAQ. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original vision and language quantization experiments, ablations, and latency and memory results in Section 5 and Appendices B–C.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results and adds an expanded group-wise weight-only evaluation in Table 3.

M1.justification: GPTQv2 is renamed GPTAQ, but the asymmetric objective, residual decomposition, Cholesky fusion, and lazy updates remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 corrects an index separator without changing the update already specified in Equation (18).

E1.justification: v3 Table 3 adds C4 for calibration and perplexity evaluation, plus OBQA and SiQA reasoning evaluations. Existing ImageNet, WikiText2, and six-task reasoning coverage is retained.

E2.justification: The group-wise weight-only comparison expands from GPTQ versus the proposed method in v1 Table 7 to include AWQ in v3 Table 3. AWQ already appeared in the separate weight-only comparison in v1 Table 6; other retained comparator sets are unchanged.

E3.justification: The revised group-wise evaluation uses 3-bit symmetric weights, group size 128, act_order, and 128 C4 calibration examples, covering LLaMA2-7B/13B and LLaMA3-8B-Instruct. v1's corresponding small comparison swept 2/3/4 bits on LLaMA2-7B. These are different experimental conditions, not directly comparable reruns.

E4.justification: v1 Appendix B.3's no-rotation bit-width study loses its 2-bit and 4-bit cases; v3's expanded group-wise comparison focuses on 3 bits. The weight-update ablation is unchanged, and the activation-order ablation moves from Appendix B.1 to Section 5.5.2 without changing its evidence.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The additional results retain the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: v3 Table 3 substantially expands group-wise weight-only evidence to two-corpus perplexity and eight-task accuracy across three models. For LLaMA3-8B-Instruct, average accuracy is 63.8 for GPTAQ, 62.5 for GPTQ, and 61.3 for AWQ. v1 Table 7's earlier bit-width results are absent rather than same-setting improvements. All retained result tables are numerically unchanged after matching names and numbering.

T1.justification: The optimization derivations, Lemma 4.1, Theorem 4.2, and Appendix A proofs remain substantively identical. Equation (22a) merely moves the equality to zero.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the claims of efficient finetuning-free asymmetric calibration, minimal implementation changes, improved quantization, and single-GPU scalability. Renaming the method does not change these contributions.

C2.justification: Explanations of accumulated upstream error, activation-order effects, and computational and memory behavior are retained. The new weight-only rankings add observations without introducing a substantive new mechanism explanation, applicability boundary, or limitation.

D1.justification: v3 documents the symmetric format, group size, act_order, and calibration source for its new group-wise experiment, and corrects Algorithm 1's index separator. The abstract's code-link target changes from the GPTQv2 repository path to GPTAQ; existing hardware, software, and memory-management details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Raffel et al. (2020) for C4 and motivates the added comparison through GPTQ's original weight-only setting. The related-work section and broader positioning against prior quantization approaches are otherwise unchanged.

P1.justification: The method is renamed throughout, template headers are corrected, publication information and a GPTQ/OPTQ naming footnote are added, and wording receives limited cleanup. Activation-order analysis moves into the main ablation section, while most exposition remains unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds the wide group-wise comparison table, removes the earlier compact no-rotation table, and relocates the activation-order table into the main text. Figures 2 and 4 are redrawn, with accompanying table renumbering and page reflow; the overall visual organization remains similar.

improvement.justification: v3 Table 3 provides broader, explicitly specified validation of group-wise weight-only quantization against GPTQ and AWQ, extending v1's single-model WikiText2 comparison to additional models, corpora, and downstream tasks. This strengthens empirical support, although removing the earlier 2-bit and 4-bit no-rotation checks reduces bit-width coverage. The resulting quality gain is limited rather than a substantial revision of the paper's foundations.
